name: SURFACEBENCH
description: Equation discovery from data is a central challenge in machine learning for science, which requires the recovery of concise symbolic expressions that govern complex physical and geometric phenomena. Recent large language model (LLM) approaches have shown promise in symbolic regression, yet existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate low-dimensional scalar functions and rely on string-level or regression-based metrics that fail to capture structural and geometric equivalence. We introduce SURFACEBENCH, the first geometry-aware benchmark for symbolic discovery of three-dimensional surfaces.
